اعترفن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَفْنَ (iʕtarafna) /iʕ.ta.raf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# اُعْتُرِفْنَ (uʕturifna) /uʕ.tu.rif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# اِعْتَرِفْنَ (iʕtarifna) /iʕ.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
